opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 893.] Motion of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers Assn. to reconsider order denying leave to file brief as amicus curiae granted, and it is now ordered that motion for leave to file be granted and brief filed.
